not_qualified.finding: Qualification failed on public task single-01 with the maker's chat template: after a correct get_price call and its mock result, the model's next token was <|tool_response> (the opening tag of a new tool result, which Gemma's generation_config lists as a stop token), so the reply was empty. One observation. A matching template gap is reported in https://github.com/google-deepmind/gemma/issues/829: with thinking off, Gemma 4's template adds no empty thought after a tool result, although it does at the start of a turn (the issue's measurements use the 26B model). In a separate test with that issue's suggested two-line fix, this model passed qualification and a full run; that result is pending publication.
